meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'they', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Они связывают нас с другими людьми.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'вязывать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'connect, bind'.

examples.text: Они связывают нас с другими людьми.

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'ступок'). Formed with a diminutive/expressive Slavic suffix adding warmth or small scale. Common masculine noun meaning 'deed, action' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Каждый поступок других людей изменяет нас.

meanings.en: to cheat on, be unfaithful to
meanings.note: Prefix 'из-' ('out from within') marks extraction or exhaustion (stem 'менять'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'changes, alters', paired with 'изменить'.

examples.text: Каждый поступок других людей изменяет нас.
examples.trans: Every action of other people changes us.
I didn't cheat on you!
He never cheated on his wife.

meanings.en: to think it over, to give it a thought
meanings.note: Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'умать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'think', paired with 'думать'.

examples.text: Подумала, ты захочешь сказать это сама.
examples.trans: I thought you would want to tell him that yourself.

examples.text: Подумай о тех, кого ты изменишь.
examples.trans: Think about those whom you will change.
